products.label: The nine named Pleiades stars, Hipparcos new reduction, CDS I/311
products.process: Keep the nine Hipparcos rows of the stars the IAU names in the Pleiades; place each at its Hipparcos position, at the cluster's distance; color by B-V and tone by Hp magnitude.
limitations: Each star's depth is the cluster's distance, chosen, not measured: its own parallax is less certain than the cluster's depth.
Positions are Hipparcos's (epoch 1991.25); the stars have moved about 1 arcsecond since.
